Rock Supreme.reason: Verified non-Canadian artist. The Northern Dial credit is the Rock Supreme who appears on Jarvis Church's 2008 album The Long Way Home. Jamaica Observer identifies Rock Supreme as Gregory Nelson, originally from Westchester in St Catherine, Jamaica, and now resident in Philadelphia.

Mr Metaphor.reason: Verified non-Canadian artist. The unresolved Mr Metaphor identity is the Brooklyn Academy MC heard on Molemen and Brooklyn Academy recordings. Brooklyn Academy's own lyrics and catalogue explicitly identify the group as coming out of Brooklyn, New York.
